description: Offline check of format and check digit for up to 50 tax or company numbers outside the EU (e.g. GB VAT, NO, AU ABN, NZ IRD, SG UEN, JP corporate number, CA BN, US EIN, IN GSTIN, BR CNPJ, MX RFC, TR, ZA, KR, AR, CL, CN, CO, IL, RU, UA) as well as EU VAT IDs and Swiss UIDs. Each answer states its depth: 'only the format was checked' or 'not supported'. It never says that a number is registered.

tax_ids.description: 1 to 50 numbers, each with its country.

number.description: The number, with or without separators.

with_receipt.description: Optional, default false. Set true only when the user asks for a signed receipt of this check for their files.

name: validate_tax_id_format
title: Validate tax ID format worldwide
